We’re Modlee, a fast growing MLOps startup, and thanks for considering joining us! Here’s a few of our highlights from this past year: we participated in the Techstars Boston Fall 2023 cohort, placed 1st in the Tech Track at the Yale Innovation Summit and launched our Python package and open-source GitHub repository in April 2024.

We are looking for machine learning experts who are enthusiastic about shaping the future of ML and MLOps and want to make a difference. With many transformative projects on the horizon, we are excited to expand our team with talented individuals who are eager to contribute to our journey!

Our Mission

Modlee is dedicated to preserving machine learning knowledge to minimize redundant and repetitive experimentation. This initiative not only saves valuable time and effort but also enables developers to concentrate on creating deployable solutions with pride. We have established a standard for documenting machine learning experiments—including datasets, models, and performance metrics. This standardization allows for the collective analysis of vast amounts of ML experiment data to determine the most effective models for specific dataset types. Our Python package facilitates users in documenting their experiments, sharing details within the community or their organizations, and receiving tailored model recommendations.

Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Come shape the future of our industry by bringing Artificial Intelligence capabilities to life!

Digital Core IT is actively looking for an AI Capabilities and Ops Associate Director to lead a technical team building and supporting solutions that improve performance and reliability of processes and systems in pharma. This role is perfect for someone with a passion for artificial intelligence and a solid background in DevOps practices, aimed at delivering high-quality solutions rapidly and effectively. If you thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments, and are skilled at leveraging both AI and DevOps to solve complex problems, then this is your opportunity to make significant impact. Are you passionate about artificial intelligence and the impact it can have across an entire industry? Are you a change agent who can influence organizations? If so, bring YOUR skills and talents to the Lilly team where you’ll have the chance to create an impact on the lives of patients!

What You'll Be Doing:

Team Leadership and Program Delivery: Manage and mentor a team of AI engineers and DevOps specialists. Oversee the design, development, and deployment of AI-infused software solutions, maintaining alignment with our company’s vision and purpose.

AI-Driven Development Strategy: Lead the strategic adoption of AI technologies within our DevOps frameworks, ensuring seamless integration and operational excellence. Introduce AI tools and algorithms that enhance automation in testing, deployment, and infrastructure management.

Innovation in Automation and Processes: Utilize AI to streamline workflows, improve the CI/CD pipeline, and optimize cloud infrastructure management. Ensure our DevOps practices incorporate the latest in AI advancements to enhance speed and quality.

Ethical AI Use and Compliance: Promote ethical practices in the use of AI within DevOps, adhering to all regulatory and compliance guidelines, and ensuring the privacy and security of data across all platforms.

Analytical and Strategic Problem Solving: Employ critical thinking to navigate complex challenges, leveraging knowledge of organizational needs and solid technical skills to deliver innovative solutions.

Technical Proficiency and Innovation: Drive different thinking and propose innovative solutions working with Lilly and vendor partners. Combine your knowledge of AI technologies with a robust understanding of DevOps principles to drive the development and optimization of our products.

Effective Communication: Articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to a diverse range of stakeholders, fostering understanding and strategic alignment.

Leadership and Team Building: Inspire and lead your team towards achieving technological excellence, promoting an environment of collaboration and continuous improvement.

Commitment to Learning: Continuously update your knowledge on the latest in AI and DevOps fields, ensuring that our practices and tools remain at the forefront of technological advancements.

Leadership Capabilities: Proven track record in leading cross-functional teams and driving complex large technical programs and enterprise capability implementations to successful completion.

Background in AI and DevOps: Demonstrated experience in managing and integrating AI within DevOps environments. Understanding of machine learning, neural networks, and their practical applications in automation and optimization.

Technical Skills: Prior experience in programming languages and technologies relevant to AI and DevOps, such as Python, Ruby, and Java. Familiarity with AI frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch,) DevOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins,) and cloud environments such as Azure and AWS.

Strategic Vision and Tactical Execution: Ability to develop strategic visions for AI-powered products and ensure their effective execution through agile DevOps practices.

Ethical and Regulatory Knowledge: Commitment to ethical AI development and a strong understanding of compliance and security protocols in software development in regulated industries.

Basic Job Functions:
• The Machine Learning (ML) Engineer is responsible for leading the development, deployment, validation, and continuous improvement of models that accurately characterize the performance of First Solar photovoltaic products and systems. He/she will achieve results through leadership of cross-functional teams to identify research needs, develop and execute analysis and test plans, and ensure quality of data collection, analysis and reporting.
• The successful candidate will be a subject matter expert in the Machine Learning space, who is able to adapt quickly to new data and analytical requests from across the First Solar organization. This may include engineering statistical analysis, contract analysis, policy analysis and project management tasks. The Machine Learning Engineer will also be responsible for orchestrating continuous integration of model artifacts to assist data scientists in generating detailed energy predictions for prospective and operating sites.
• The ideal candidate will build relationships with internal and external groups to research state of the art meteorological analysis, statistical analysis, energy prediction methods & tools, and recommendations for PV power plant design in support of their work. He/she will identify outstanding bottlenecks in the data infrastructure, support and enhance existing systems and productionize AI environments for modeling and forecasting.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Statistics, or Physics required. Advanced degree is a plus.
• At least 10 years in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning algorithm development.

• Proficient with programming languages (Python, Matlab, R, or similar), relational databases (SQL Server), data analysis and visualization software's (preferably JMP, Power BI, SAS).

IBM Apprenticeship Program is an official registered apprenticeship recognized by the Department of Labor (DOL). Every graduate of a Registered Apprenticeship program receives a nationally-recognized credential from the DOL.
